gasket_procurement: Selected thickness +/-0.10mm is a required batch selection, not standard supplier stock tolerance. Require pressure <=0.080MPa throughout20..35% compression after thermal/wet conditioning. Obtain supplier approval for knife-cut12/10mm strips on carrier liner and bonded scarf; no unsupported narrow die-cut claim.
pressure_status: provisional design upper bound; actual fan shutoff and fault differential must be supplied; no operation above envelope

seals.acceptance: HX allowable force OPEN;1000N fixture limit is not service capacity
force curve/batch and leakage test OPEN; Pocket also has unresolved crown interference
force curve/batch and leakage test OPEN; Pocket also has unresolved crown interference

face_gap_budget.acceptance: Measure actual opposed gap at20 stations with core on fixed support datums. Reject outside4.20..4.70 at qualified cold/hot state. Tolerances are worst-case additive, not RSS.

carrier.scope: Simply-supported span under maximum accepted batch pressure; continuous skirt seam and rail backing at notches required. Does not prove the complete HX frame.

face_clamps.preload_interpretation: Bolt preload is an upper-bound fastener demand, not a proved toe reaction. Sleeve/stop/frame contact stiffness and jaw seating determine force split. Demonstrate measured contact force and full seal compression; the20-bolt sum alone is not acceptance.
face_clamps.bearing_basis: Conservative500N on actual12x3mm positive-stop contact; local frame bending and force split still require owner acceptance
face_clamps.status: LOCAL_JAW_CARRIER_SCREEN_ONLY; HX frame force/thermal sliding and loaded datum acceptance OPEN. M5 standoff1.5kN proof and representative clamp-loop test required.

left_end_support.load_path: Bottom Y-end frame -> jaw/short M5 sleeve and positive stop -> carrier ->8mm shelf/two3mm gussets ->30x16x3 mount -> unchanged Shell RHS side; no load through fins/copper/skin
left_end_support.plate_basis: Conservative ungusseted shelf screen; no stiffness credit taken for gussets
left_end_support.qualification: Actual25mm RHS wall/corner fit, a3 weld access/procedure, local wall bending and complete bracket1.5kN proof OPEN. Test bracket/sleeve separately from500N jaw. Thin jaw plate/contact behaviour and actual collector clearance require loaded/tolerance qualification. Upper long ties are rejected, not installed.

long_edge_after_H02_clearance.left_bearing: Continuous nominal1.55mm ground strip plus8mm gusseted bearing extensions at two Y-end clamps; fixed core planes unchanged
long_edge_after_H02_clearance.status: Shell carrier reinforced; HX HOLD: left edge is restrained through Y-end frame, conservatively screened over652mm. Isolated20x8 rail does not qualify. Actual coupled core frame stiffness or joint HX collector/hold-down revision required before manufacture; do not apply20x500N.

glands.material: DOWSIL7091 cured silicone,2mm lip/membrane;12mm jacket axial lap;0.4mm slit with renewed20x1.5mm splice
glands.load_path: guard ->3mm washer/M4x16 removable screw ->3.5mm blind thread in5mm backer;2mm metal stop excludes seal preload. Backer bears against skin and is continuously edge-fused. Pressure reaction is bonded, not applied as fictitious50kPa compression on guard.
glands.qualification: Average adhesion/shear screening does not prove edge peel or cyclic movement. Actual jacket/paint coupons, +/-4mm axial and +/-1mm radial movement,1000N blind-thread proof, wet ageing and leak/spray test remain OPEN.

A_post_welds.joint: CJP single-bevel T-butt,3mm web,0.5mm root face and gap,45deg bevel; matching consumable
A_post_welds.web_stress_method: Use actual transfer force from frame model divided by3*257; combine normal and shear by von Mises. Spring includes conservative6mm equivalent weld length in addition to19mm clear web.
A_post_welds.capacity_status: CONDITIONAL on demonstrated full root fusion and matching parent-strength weld. Unqualified joint has no released capacity; eight locations alone are insufficient.
A_post_welds.fabrication: Weld webs before pipe/insulation installation. Removable copper root backing from open channel ends; alternate short backsteps on opposing sides. Grind outer X faces flush+0/-0.1. Qualify actual3mm T coupon with macro/root-fusion and bend examination;100%VT and applicable surface examination. Do not call this a sub3mm structural fillet.

water_skid.model: Conservative40mm effective plate strip cantilever40mm; two5mm RHS walls of40mm bearing length compress over80mm. Floor/grout/anchor compliance excluded. Full floor-pad bearing required.

custom_top_washer.basis: Simply supported washer net strip across14mm slot, central full25kN bolt preload. Actual contact/edge bearing and batch certificate still required.

water_skid.ground_anchor_status: Demand only; no selected anchor or concrete/substrate data. No lifting/forklift or unrestrained transport release. All6 owner2g vertical reactions remain compressive; lateral transport not specified.
water_skid.qualification: Friction coefficient>=0.15 after actual coating/conditioning required; otherwise design positive shear keys. Owner must recalculate six-foot reactions using measured ground stiffness/settlement. Bolt length changes with0..5mm owner shim.

distribution.status: OPEN_FRAME installed; optional plate stiffness/rail deflection must be accepted before fitting a plate.1000Pa is an upper envelope, not a measured plate loss. Service bridge/trolley must be locked and loaded before cassette release.

condensate.scope: Four independent traps upstream of any common tundish; pressure-water relief kept separate. Priming, visible air gap, cleanout and negative-pressure inlet fall are required. This sizing alone is not a completed drain assembly.

support.status: Conditional screen; floor/substrate and dissimilar weld qualification OPEN. Hose must qualify relative motion; stiffness does not by itself prove zero HX nozzle reaction. Receptor collar now represented.
